messages.content:
Review the following commit message against its diff.

=== MESSAGE ===
Rename Store.GetUser to FindUser

Align the lookup method with the rest of the store API, which already
uses the Find* prefix for single-row reads. This is a pure rename with
no behaviour change; updates the API handler and the store test to the
new name.


=== DIFF ===
diff --git a/store/user.go b/store/user.go
index 111aaa..222bbb 100644
--- a/store/user.go
+++ b/store/user.go
@@ -14,8 +14,8 @@ type Store struct {
 	db *sql.DB
 }
 
-// GetUser loads a user by id.
-func (s *Store) GetUser(ctx context.Context, id int64) (*User, error) {
+// FindUser loads a user by id.
+func (s *Store) FindUser(ctx context.Context, id int64) (*User, error) {
 	row := s.db.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE id = ?", id)
 	return scanUser(row)
 }
diff --git a/api/handler.go b/api/handler.go
index 333ccc..444ddd 100644
--- a/api/handler.go
+++ b/api/handler.go
@@ -22,7 +22,7 @@ func (h *Handler) user(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
 		http.Error(w, "bad id", http.StatusBadRequest)
 		return
 	}
-	u, err := h.store.GetUser(r.Context(), id)
+	u, err := h.store.FindUser(r.Context(), id)
 	if err != nil {
 		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
 		return
diff --git a/store/user_test.go b/store/user_test.go
index 555eee..666fff 100644
--- a/store/user_test.go
+++ b/store/user_test.go
@@ -30,7 +30,7 @@ func TestGetUser(t *testing.T) {
 	defer cleanup()
 
-	u, err := s.GetUser(ctx, 1)
+	u, err := s.FindUser(ctx, 1)
 	if err != nil {
 		t.Fatal(err)
 	}
